# Keep draft notices available when browser history passes through the profile

## What & Why
The current regression coverage verifies browser back and forward between the answer library and opportunity queue. A history sequence that passes through Profile should also preserve each unsaved draft notice so users do not lose recovery options when checking settings.

## Done looks like
- An answer draft notice remains available after navigating answers → profile → applications → back and forward through browser history.
- An opportunity draft notice remains available through the same history sequence.
- An expired draft still announces that it is unavailable after returning through history.
